motus-strength-ii.d: The Motus Strength II is the latest version of our pinnacle barefoot strength trainer, now with a new tongue construction for a secure, adaptable fit, plus a ribbed KPU overlay for full range of motion, enhanced flex and airflow. A supportive upper with durable, breathable mesh offers total protection and unmatched connection, while raised lugs provide grip and stability under heavy loads.
motus-strength-ii.fitW: Fits large - go one size down

gobi-iii-sneaker-leather.d: The Gobi III Sneaker Leather combines timeless sneaker style with barefoot freedom. Made with natural materials including chrome-free premium leather, it's lightweight, flexible, and shaped like your foot, letting every step feel instinctive and effortless.

sensus-ii-grounding.d: Modern footwear inspired by ancestral wisdom. Drawing inspiration from humanity's earliest foot coverings, this premium Wild Hide leather moccasin fits and feels like a glove for your feet. The Sensus II evolves the original with conductive technology - enabling grounding practice that connects your body to Earth's energy on natural surfaces.

primus-flow-knit.d: The Primus Flow Knit combines natural barefoot performance with adaptive comfort. A seamless 360° knit upper creates a breathable, lightweight, sock-like fit that flexes with your foot, while an unstructured heel window supports natural alignment. Textured laces and engineered lace loops deliver secure lockdown without restricting movement.

primus-trail-fg-3-5.d: Hit the trail to rewild yourself and reconnect with nature. The Primus Trail 3.5 FG is a light, durable, flexible trail-running trainer that brings us one step closer to circular footwear.

ra-iv.d: The Ra IV reimagines the classic Oxford through a barefoot lens - smart in appearance and uncompromising in feel and natural movement. Crafted with Wild Hide leather, organic cotton laces, and a cork insole, and sitting on a flexible 4mm Gobi outsole that keeps you connected to every step, the Ra IV is built to support strong, free feet no matter the occasion.

primus-lite-iv.d: Our best-selling barefoot training all-rounder, now re-engineered for smarter material use. The Primus Lite IV delivers the same trusted barefoot feel with recycled, vegan* materials - made for moving naturally, whether you're running or working out. Wide, thin and flexible to elevate every workout, now with a lighter footprint.

primus-trail-flow.d: Meet the new Primus Trail Flow, a natural off-road performer. This streamlined silhouette provides both exceptional grip and responsive ground feel to move mindfully across a variety of terrains. The durable, breathable 100% recycled polyester mesh upper keeps those agile feet cool and secure with engineered, anti-slip lacing.

sensus-yin-slide.d: Meet the Sensus Yin Slide, taking style cues from its sister, the Sensus Yin Sandal. Just as minimal, this perfect travel companion's designed to be thrown on with something floaty or thrown in a bag for the beach or pool. Made of chrome-free leather, with minimal stitchlines and an adjustable fit for ultimate comfort.

primus-lite-knit-natural.d: Slip into the knitted sock of the Primus Lite Knit Natural - now created with a 92% Tencel™, 7% Hotmelt and 1% Roica upper - and instantly feel the benefit of fit. This super-flexible update to our beloved barefoot performance trainer is still just as ready to move however you train, just more natural.

motus-flex-natural.d: The Motus Flex Natural - the same freedom and flexibility you love about the Motus Flex, now with more natural materials. It keeps the ultra-flexible, stripped-back design for primal movement, calisthenics and bodyweight training, incorporating natural yarns and an outsole made using 50% natural rubber.
motus-flex-natural.fit: Fits large - go one size down

gobi-ii-sneaker-premium-leather.d: This is our most natural style yet, constructed with 98% natural materials and a 100% natural outsole made in partnership with NFW. With its classic sneaker outline, innovative materials, and barefoot fit and feel, the Gobi Sneaker Premium redefines what it means to move as nature intended.
